title: Duskwood · Where the Lanterns Hold

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: The Night Watch
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Defeat 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages at Tranquil Gardens, south of Darkshire.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: The town needs another defender on the cemetery road.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Investigate the Moonbrook Schoolhouse for information about Stalvan.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: The introductory errand #66 is complete; the investigation continues with #67.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: The Valor Family
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Search Raven Hill for a Raven Hill Tome and bring it to Sirra in Darkshire.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: A Forever story about preserving the memory of a local family. The book has not yet been recovered.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: Worgen in the Woods
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Defeat 6 Nightbane Shadow Weavers for Calor in Darkshire.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: The Nightbane threat reaches beyond the town’s lamps.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: The Totem of Infliction
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Bring Madame Eva 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: A protective charm requires materials from the very threats haunting the forest.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: Look to the Stars
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Bring Viktori one Bronze Tube for his stargazing device.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: An attempt to understand the forest through observation as well as magic.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Collect 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and return to Chef Grual.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: Even a frightened town needs a working kitchen. Forever requires the flanks, without the old separate seasoning errand.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: Raven Hill
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Investigate the supposed haunting of Raven Hill; the destination is Jitters.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: An unexplained light and moving shadows draw attention to the western ruins.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: Deliveries to Sven
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Carry the provided supplies to Sven Yorgen’s camp in northwestern Duskwood.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: Sven’s small company cannot spare a defender to collect supplies.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: The Hermit
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Check on the old man, Abercrombie, in his shack near Raven Hill Cemetery.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: An apparently simple welfare visit opens another thread. Xuthar has not yet made the visit.

newlyObservedActiveQuests.name: Crime and Punishment
newlyObservedActiveQuests.objective: Obtain the Hand of Dextren Ward in the Stormwind Stockade for Millstipe.
newlyObservedActiveQuests.story: Accepted in Darkshire, with an objective in a different zone. This newly accepted request does not change the recorded Stockade victories.

completion.name: The Legend of Stalvan
completion.stage: Introduction: Madame Eva to Clerk Daltry

interpretation: Newly observed active quests since the preceding verified public snapshot. The API does not return acceptance times or per-objective progress. The screenshot and player announcement establish arrival in Darkshire. Personal motive and dialogue in the novel are roleplay.
